title: Lattice Yang–Mills Mass Gaps and the Continuum Cube Criterion
description: The Gaussian block action has a sharp spatial decay rate of order b^(-1/2). A constrained heat-bath estimate gives a quantitative sufficient condition for the Wilson covariance bound. James Montgomery Lockwood is credited for the internal-fibre formulation that motivated this approach. The weak-coupling Wilson estimates and the nontrivial continuum construction remain open.
